name: Mechanical Properties & Testing
summary: Defines stress, strain, stiffness, strength, ductility and hardness, and shows how they are measured and why they differ between material classes.

topics.name: Engineering stress and strain; tension, compression, shear and torsion
Elastic deformation: Hooke's law, Young's, shear and bulk moduli, Poisson's ratio
Generalised Hooke's law and elastic anisotropy
Atomic origin of elasticity; rubber elasticity versus energy elasticity
The tensile test: yield strength, tensile strength, ductility, resilience and toughness
True stress and true strain; necking and the Considère criterion
Strain hardening and the Hollomon equation
Hardness testing: Brinell, Rockwell, Vickers, Knoop and nanoindentation
Compression, bend (flexural) and torsion tests; testing brittle materials
Variability of properties, statistics of test data and design/safety factors
Mechanical behaviour of ceramics and polymers compared with metals
Test standards (ASTM/ISO) and test machines, extensometers and strain gauges
